name: Mobile review reproduction
audience: Independent app developers with a recent release and a specific reported first-use problem
offer: Investigate one agreed review complaint or customer journey, deliver recorded evidence and reproduction steps, and include one scoped retest.
hypothesis: Developers with a current complaint will pay for independent reproducible evidence and a retest rather than another unverified bug list.
successCriteria: At least one independent developer agrees to a specific journey and acceptance condition.
A completed investigation contains actual environment evidence and is acknowledged as useful by the customer.
A paid order is verified separately from free pilots; a repeat test or referral is recorded when it occurs.
killCriteria: Pause paid fulfillment if the agreed app, device or test account cannot be accessed; do not substitute a different environment silently.
Pause if findings cannot be reproduced or provider failures are repeatedly mistaken for product bugs.
After at least five qualified permitted exposures and their agreed response windows, reconsider the offer if no developer states a current problem or takes a substantive next step.
evidenceRequirements: Customer-authorized target, journey, synthetic data and expected result.
Run/session identifiers, actual device or browser environment, timestamps, screenshots or recording, and reproduction attempt.
Explicit passed, failed, blocked or inconclusive result; actual customer acknowledgment, costs and intervention records.

name: Authorized property listing reels
audience: Real estate agents currently promoting a listing and authorized to supply its photos and facts
offer: Produce one short silent vertical property video from authorized photos, with approved facts in an accompanying manifest and a downloadable MP4. A changed scope requires a new order.
hypothesis: An agent with a current listing will use and buy a ready-to-publish clip when the sample is accurate and removes editing work.
successCriteria: At least one independent listing agent supplies or authorizes actual assets and confirms an immediate marketing use.
The customer approves an accurate playable export and confirms receipt or publication; those outcomes are recorded separately.
Verified payment and observed production cost support continuing a small repeat test.
killCriteria: Block production when image or recording permission and listing facts are unconfirmed.
Pause if exports repeatedly fail playback, accuracy or agreed revision checks.
After at least five qualified permitted exposures and their response windows, change the audience or offer if no agent supplies a real listing or takes a substantive next step.
evidenceRequirements: Source asset references, customer permission and approved listing facts.
Playable rendered file, file version, dimensions/duration and quality check results.
Customer approval and receipt/publication evidence, verified payment if paid, actual cost and intervention records.

name: Requested browser microtools
audience: Makers and small teams with a specific unmet browser-based task and concrete example inputs and outputs
offer: Configure one supported offline browser utility (CSV deduplication, JSON formatting or UTM building) against agreed input/output examples and deliver a tested downloadable HTML file.
hypothesis: A person who has already requested a small utility will use a working version and may pay for a scoped improvement or private version.
successCriteria: An independent requester confirms the task and supplies at least one meaningful acceptance example.
The delivered tool passes agreed examples and the requester completes the intended task.
A verified paid order, requested improvement or independent repeat use provides an early commercial or retention signal.
killCriteria: Decline tasks needing production secrets, privileged third-party accounts, unrestricted code execution or unsupported infrastructure.
Pause if the build cannot pass its agreed examples within the job's time and cost cap.
After at least five qualified permitted exposures and their response windows, reconsider the task cluster if no requester supplies concrete examples or actually uses an output.
evidenceRequirements: Original request reference, permission to follow up, explicit scope and input/output examples.
Isolated build result, source/artifact version, test output and working preview or bundle.
Observed customer task completion, price/payment mode, costs and any founder repair or deployment work.

name: Indie product launch clips
audience: Independent software makers preparing a launch or demo with a working product and permission to supply its screen recordings
offer: Produce one short silent vertical product clip from supplied authorized screenshots or an operator-provided recording, with approved facts in an accompanying manifest and a downloadable MP4.
hypothesis: A maker with an imminent launch will use a ready-to-share demonstration of the actual product and pay to avoid recording and editing it themselves.
successCriteria: At least one independent maker supplies an authorized working flow or recording and a real intended publication or presentation.
The maker approves and receives a playable clip that accurately represents the product.
Actual presentation/publication, verified payment or a repeat request is recorded rather than inferred from a download.
killCriteria: Block if source access or media rights are missing, or the proposed flow cannot actually be demonstrated.
Pause when producing the clip repeatedly requires false UI states, invented capabilities or unbounded manual edits.
After at least five qualified permitted exposures and their response windows, change the audience or offer if no maker supplies a real launch need or uses an output.
evidenceRequirements: Customer-approved flow, asset permission and actual captured or supplied source recording.
Versioned playable export, source/fact manifest checks and any separately approved revised order.
Customer approval, receipt and any actual publication evidence, verified payment if paid, costs and intervention records.
